_comment: Ground truth for filenames that filename_ground_truth.decompose() ABSTAINS on.
Every entry was settled by opening the document, and carries the evidence that
settled it. An entry may only exist for a stem the parser abstains on -- there
is a test that fails otherwise -- so this file can never quietly override a
working rule, which is how override tables normally rot.
Entries with confidence 'review' are NOT applied; they are questions for the owner.
